tools.name: prepare_document
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to sign a document, or have someone else sign it, and you can pass the file: an attached file, an upload_id from create_upload, an HTTPS link to the file, or a small file as base64. Accepts PDF, Word (.docx) or image (PNG/JPG) files up to 25 MB (base64 up to 3 MB). Store

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to sign a file that you can read but can't attach directly, such as a file in your sandbox or workspace. Returns a one-time upload URL. Upload the file with an HTTP PUT using exactly the given headers, then call prepare_document with upload_id. Accepts PDF, Word (.docx),

tools.name: get_upload_page_link
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to sign a document but you can't pass the file to YouNeedToSign. Returns a link to youneedtosign.com, where the user opens the file in their browser and signs it. Nothing is uploaded unless they choose Share.

tools.name: sign_document_typed
tools.description: Use this when the user wants their own typed name as the signature (and optionally a date) added without the signing view. Creates a new signed copy; the original is kept. Only sign with the user's own name.

tools.name: register_signed_document
tools.description: Called by the YouNeedToSign signing view after the user signs. Saves the signed copy and returns its links.

tools.name: get_signing_link
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a link so someone else can sign, or asks whether someone has saved a shared document. YouNeedToSign does not send emails; the user shares the link.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to delete their document and its signed copies now, before automatic deletion.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_upload, get_signing_link · Private data: prepare_document, create_upload, get_upload_page_link, sign_document_typed, register_signed_document, get_signing_link, delete_document · Public sink: prepare_document, create_upload, get_upload_page_link, get_signing_link · Destructive: delete_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_upload, get_signing_link · Private data: prepare_document, create_upload, get_upload_page_link, sign_document_typed, register_signed_document, get_signing_link, delete_document · Public sink: prepare_document, create_upload, get_upload_page_link, get_signing_link · Destructive: delete_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
